moments.author: Sam Altman
moments.quote: I am very uncomfortable about people trying to ascribe religious force or a surrender of human judgment to AI models. It is a real safety issue.
moments.why: His blunt warning about treating AI like a religion struck a nerve amid rising AI debates.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: SpaceX is a super intelligence company... will rename SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI.
moments.why: His renaming quip and rebranding of SpaceXAI to 'SpaceXSI' is catchily provocative and meme-ready.

moments.author: Scott Bessent
moments.quote: Plans to propose an emergency AI notification process between the U.S. and China if something goes wrong — and thinks Beijing would agree.
moments.why: A rare public nod toward AI diplomacy between superpowers, trailing major tech tension.
